title: PGP Detached Signature Verifier
description: Paste an ASCII-armored OpenPGP public key, detached signature and the signed file, and this page verifies the signature offline: Ed25519 (v4 legacy EdDSA and v6) and ECDSA P-256, RFC 9580 and RFC 4880 v4 packet parsing, armor CRC24, key fingerprint and key id, signature creation time and key expiry when present. The cryptography is the MIT-licensed @noble/curves and @noble/hashes libraries tree-shaken and inlined into this single page; OpenPGP.js is intentionally left out (LGPL-3.0 licence and page size). A #selftest=1 fragment runs the bundled golden vectors end to end: gpg-generated Ed25519 and P-256 keys verify VALID, a tampered artifact reads INVALID, and the RFC 9580 Appendix A samples verify against the standard's own bytes. Runs entirely in the browser, zero network, zero storage, deterministic.

signature_armored.description: The ASCII-armored detached signature over the artifact

artifact.description: The signed artifact; a binary file can be picked locally and is verified byte for byte

mcp_tool_definition.name: verify_pgp_detached_signature
mcp_tool_definition.description: Verifies an OpenPGP detached signature offline: parses armor with CRC24, public-key packets (Ed25519 legacy EdDSA, Ed25519 v6, ECDSA P-256) and signature packets v4/v6, then verifies the signature and reports VALID or INVALID with key fingerprint, key id, creation time and expiry, or UNSUPPORTED with the algorithm id.
